note: Both sets capture the main deck assembly facts (2"x8" joist/frame, 4-1/2" SIP with vapor barrier, 8D ring-shank nail at 6" O.C. each side, continuous sealant and waterproofing, PL 8 x 3/8 with 7/16" holes at 12" O.C.), and both misattribute the 1'-3 1/4" segment dimension to RAILING ATTACHMENT and repeat the garbled "ANK NAIL" fragment. Set A binds the first-floor elevation to grade level 0" with the needed condition and gives the hex bolt's diameter and length and the scaffold footing's "adjustable" type, whereas Set B drops those and adds unsupported conditions ("FIRST FLR" on the plywood/deck claims, "center to center" on the 1'-4 3/4" dimension, "connection to joist" on the railing post bracket). Set B also repeats more facts (frame, joist, railing post bracket, sealant, SIP each stated twice) and misassigns the plywood as "deck" material/thickness under FIRST FLR. Set A is the more faithful set overall, though it too loses the 2"x8" FRAME and the A3 scale.
remarks: Text layer is fragmented ("ANK NAIL @ 6\" O.C. EACH" is a broken run of "8D RING SHANK NAIL @ 6\" O.C. EACH SIDE"); both sets propagated this fragment as a claim. The dimensions 1'-4 3/4", 1'-4", 1'-3 1/4" (summing to the 4'-0" module) sit in detail A3 DECK MODULE TO MODULE CONNECTION, not C1 RAILING ATTACHMENT, so both sets' bindings of these dimensions are wrong. Important facts both sets miss: W10 X 15, 3" STEEL DECKING, 3" WOOD LAG SCREW WITH WASHER, 3/8" x 4" HEX THROUGH BOLT, CLEARVUE CABLE RAILING, and the 8'-0"/5'-2 1/2"/4'-0" dimensions; note the 3/4" exterior grade plywood is a deck layer distinct from the 3" steel decking, so labeling it simply "deck(ing) material" is misleading.
